evals.name: opens-with-counts
evals.setup: The `srd` gap store holds 10 open gaps: 3 with `answer: deferred`, 2 with `answer: unknown`, and 5 plain gaps with no `answer`.

evals.name: reclassifies-rather-than-skipping
evals.setup: Working the deferred list, the user answers the one deferred gap's question with "actually nobody knows that yet" — it was filed as deferred but is really an unknown.

evals.name: clusters-gaps-and-drafts-outside-the-corpus
evals.setup: Three open gaps, two of which report the same missing fact from different SRDs. The corpus covers a third of that fact already, but in an unranked page. Once the draft is ready, the user publishes it in the sitting and gives its URL; the docs pull that brings it into the corpus has not run yet.

evals.name: sweeps-an-abandoned-srd
evals.setup: SRD `initiatives/crew-seats/srd.md` has Lifecycle `WITHDRAWN`, the value the SRD standard gives a document that will not be built; `initiatives/payload-booking/srd.md` is `APPROVED`. KB page `kb/mission-portal.md` has three sections whose attestation line names `crew-seats`: "Crew seat booking" (only it), "Mission visibility" (co-attested by `payload-booking`), and "Crew seat limit", which open `wrong` gap `gap-0040` (`srd_ref` `crew-seats`) already reverts; a fourth section cites only `payload-booking`. The store also holds one deferred and one plain open gap.

evals.name: rechecks-stale-gaps
evals.setup: The store holds one plain open gap and three `filled` gaps `list_gaps` flags stale. `gap-0050` cites KB section `kb/scrub-refunds.md#customer-scrub-refund` (`changed`): reworded, it still states the 80% refund for a customer-caused scrub. `gap-0051` cites `kb/scrub-refunds.md#refund-claim-deadline` (`changed`): its claim says a scrub refund has no claim deadline; the section now sets a 60-day deadline. `gap-0052` cites `1000000110#recordings` (`vanished`): that heading is now "Cold archive" and states the same 30-day fact. No SRD is abandoned.

evals.name: ask-writes-one-message-per-person
evals.setup: Three open deferred gaps: `gap-0061` names two people in `ask` (Maya R, John K) and was never asked; `gap-0062` names Maya R and was asked on 2026-09-28; `gap-0063` names nobody. Once the blocks are printed, the user confirms both were sent.
